pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/VoiceLab.tsx:132 The bench's Play all loop only exits when Stop or a new play bumps the run counter, and voiceAudio's AudioContext lives at module level, so leaving the Voice tab mid-bench leaves the current line sounding and the loop starts the next lines after the surface is gone.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/characters/VoiceLab.tsx:132 No unmount cleanup anywhere (no useEffect / stopPcm on unmount in VoiceLab, VoiceTab or voiceAudio). The technique names 'audio that keeps playing after its surface is gone' as the defining leak.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/voiceAudio.ts:45 playPcm resolves only on onended. c.resume() is not awaited and there is no deadline derived from samples/sampleRate, yet the bench queue awaits it before starting the next line. A suspended context or a dead device leaves 'Playing…' stuck until a human presses Stop.

apps/console/src/pages/characters/names.ts:48 Hand-maintained second engine list in a display map. The form also branches on engine identity (VoiceTab.tsx:119 provider === "kokoro"). The Record<VoiceProvider,…> name map is compile-checked but this array is not, so a new provider would be silently missing from the picker.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/voiceAudio.ts:33 No audio output gives one honest sentence (shown as audioError), never a dead button. A single `current` source means one line plays at a time.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/VoiceLab.tsx:117 The preview reports whether the render carried a timeline or the face falls back to amplitude, so the timing source is recorded rather than hidden.
apps/console/src/pages/characters/voiceAudio.ts:1 Output-only surface. No capture (no getUserMedia) here or anywhere in the product's source.

pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/Cargo.toml:3 Reconcile is a between-streams text analysis crate: its 'synthesis' is an LLM synthesis prompt and its 'transcripts' are text sim transcripts. Substring searches of the whole crate for microphone, tts, viseme, audio, speech and playback found zero files; the only 'voice' hits are prose about a character's or patron's voice.
